The EPA’s Seven Cardinal Rules of Risk Communication Adapted by Dr. Vincent T. Covello from the 1988 EPA Seven Cardinal Rules of Risk. Accept and involve the public/other consumers as legitimate partners (e.g. stakeholders). 1. Plan carefully and evaluate your efforts with a focus on your strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats (SWOT). 2. Listen to the stakeholders’ specific concerns.3. Be honest, frank, and open. 4. Coordinate and collaborate with other credible sources. 5. Meet the needs of the media. 6. Speak clearly and with compassion. http://www.orau.gov/cdcynergy/erc/Content/activeinformation/resources/EPA_Seven_Cardinal_Rules.pdf.
